_changelog: 1.2 (2026-08-12): Updated product rule to in-scene AI render (no more rembg cutout). Added font_mapping, font_sizing, logo_min_size_px. Enlarged logo position boxes for 120px minimum height.
1.1 (original): Initial 8-layout template set with zone_rules, logo_positions, canvas_presets.
coordinate_system: relative (0.0-1.0 as fraction of canvas width/height). Compositing node multiplies by target canvas size at render time. Box format: [x0, y0, x1, y1] = top-left to bottom-right.

font_mapping._description: Bridges this template's abstract role names to actual BrandKit (liitt-brand-kit.json) font roles and colour tokens. Compositor uses this table at render time — Vision Planner references these role names in copywriting output.

mood_color.note: Dynamic — Planner picks from mood spectrum. Pass hex directly.

body.note: Dusty Purple Gray — editorial body. Not a BrandKit token; hardcoded in zone_rules.

font_sizing._description: How compositor determines font pixel sizes from zone boxes. Headline auto-fits to its box; subheadline and body scale relative to headline's final size.
font_sizing.headline: auto-fit to box height using binary-size descent. Start at 80% of box pixel height, decrement by 4px until wrapped text fits within box bounds. Minimum: 32px (IG Feed) / 36px (TikTok). Maximum: 120px.
font_sizing.logo: Fit to box maintaining aspect ratio. Enforce logo_min_size_px from zone_rules.logo; if box is too small, scale box outward (preserving center point) until logo hits 120px minimum height.

zone_rules.product: Rendered IN-SCENE by AI (Nanobanana2 / fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit), seamlessly blended with background. NOT separately composited — the image model places the product natively within the generated scene. Vision Planner must describe product position, angle, and contextual props in natural language within [CREATIVE DIRECTION]. CRITICAL: product packaging text, colors, proportions, and shape must remain IDENTICAL to the original — model must preserve, not redesign.
zone_rules.logo: Original asset paste only (brand-assets wordmark PNG from BrandKit), never re-generated by AI. Position chosen from logo_positions presets below. Minimum rendered height: 120px — if the logo_position box is too small for the target canvas, compositor scales it up preserving center point. Never stretch, distort, or recolor.
zone_rules.headline: Rendered via compositor PIL. Font: font_mapping.display_bold → BrandKit 'display' (Bricolage Grotesque Bold). Color: font_mapping.color_mapping.headline_primary (#F4F1E8) or headline_alt (#E8B84A). Auto-fit to box per font_sizing.headline rules.
zone_rules.subheadline: Rendered via compositor PIL. Font: font_mapping.ui_label → BrandKit 'eyebrow' (Hanken Grotesk, 600 weight, 2px tracking). Color: mood_color (dynamic — Planner picks hex from liitt mood spectrum). Size: font_sizing.subheadline × headline size.
zone_rules.body: OPTIONAL zone. Only render if: (a) template has body.supported = true, AND (b) Vision Planner or user supplies body copy. Font: font_mapping.editorial_body → BrandKit 'body' (Newsreader, weight 420). Color: #8E899F (Dusty Purple Gray). Size: font_sizing.body × headline size. If template's body.supported is false, Planner MUST select a different layout when body copy is requested.
zone_rules.safe_zone_background: Full canvas [0,0,1,1]. Zones above define PROTECTED areas — Vision Planner instructs AI model to keep these areas as clean dark negative space. Compositor will overwrite these zones with rendered text/logo, but AI-generated content in protected zones creates visual clash.

logo_positions._description: Pre-defined logo anchor boxes. All boxes widened and heightened vs v1.1 to accommodate 120px minimum logo height on both IG Feed (min 120px in 1350px canvas ≈ 8.9%) and TikTok (min 120px in 1920px ≈ 6.25%). Box heights set to ~11% for comfortable margin.

body.note: Product dominates 68% of canvas — no whitespace left for a description line. Use rule-of-thirds or asymmetric variants if body copy is required.
